constants.source: GM and volumetric mean radius as printed in the NASA/JPL Horizons object-data pages of bodies 10, 599 and 399 (body GM, not planet-system GM); see provenance.sources. g0 is the defined standard gravity.

residuals.method: SciPy DOP853, rtol 1e-10, atol 1e-3 km / 1e-9 km/s, compared with the Lambert target

provenance.notes: Planet positions/velocities and GM values are NASA/JPL Horizons data read from the local verified cache (data_mode says cached or live). The transfer arc, burns and propellant are computed by this project with a simplified model: Sun-only two-body coast, zero-revolution prograde Lambert arc, impulsive burns from circular 12-hour parking orbits, no launch, atmosphere, third bodies or finite burns. NASA did not compute or certify this route. Lambert solver: lamberthub 1.0.0 izzo2015 (GPL-3.0).
